metadata.question: Did temperatures exceed 100 degrees fahrenheit in Prescott, Arizona during the month of June in 2017?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use ERA5-Land hourly 2m air temperature (ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY) for June 2017 over a 15 km buffer around Prescott, AZ. If empty, fallback to ERA5 hourly (ECMWF/ERA5/HOURLY).
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed (reanalysis). Use all pixels; count valid pixels to ensure data presence.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs. Null/Error: Check collection size (C1), valid pixel count after reduction (C2), and ensure the computed max temperature is not null/NaN and within plausible range (C3).
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

function getInfoAsync(obj) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    obj.getInfo((value, err) => {
      if (err) reject(err);
      else resolve(value);
    });
  });
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-112.4685, 34.54]); // Prescott, AZ
    const region = point.buffer(15000).bounds(); // 15 km buffer
    const start = '2017-06-01';
    const end = '2017-07-01';

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    let col = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY')
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .select('temperature_2m');

    const sizeLand = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    console.log('Date range: 2017-06-01 to 2017-07-01');
    console.log('Location: Prescott, AZ (15 km buffer)');
    console.log('ERA5-Land Images: ' + sizeLand);

    if (sizeLand === 0) {
      let colFb = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5/HOURLY')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .select(['2m_temperature'], ['temperature_2m']);
      const sizeFb = await getInfoAsync(colFb.size());
      console.log('Using ERA5 (fallback) Images: ' + sizeFb);
      if (sizeFb === 0) {
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
      col = colFb;
    }

    // 3. Processing: Max over time, then reduce over region
    const maxImg = col.select('temperature_2m').max();

    const countDict = maxImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: 9000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    });
    const pixCount = await getInfoAsync(countDict.get('temperature_2m')) || 0;
    console.log('Valid pixels (count): ' + pixCount);
    if (pixCount === 0) {
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    const maxDict = maxImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.max(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: 9000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    });
    const maxK = await getInfoAsync(maxDict.get('temperature_2m'));
    if (maxK === null || maxK === undefined || isNaN(maxK)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation: Convert to Fahrenheit
    const maxF = maxK * 9 / 5 - 459.67;
    console.log('Max hourly 2m air temp (F): ' + maxF.toFixed(1));

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    if (maxF < -100 || maxF > 150) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const exceeded = maxF > 100.0;
    console.log('Threshold 100F exceeded?: ' + (exceeded ? 'Yes' : 'No'));
    console.log(exceeded ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('Error: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : err));
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
